Two-step OwnershipTransferred completed to zero-timelock 6-of-11 Safe 0x8b4334d4812C530574Bd4F2763FcD22dE94A969B, closing the 17.68-day SystemRegistry EOA ownership gap.
Safe 0x8b4334... replaced SystemSecurity (0x027a... -> 0xe57A2eC5EF4CC7F6576BB1ed5Ec3759878F39B20), SwapRouter (0x6201... -> 0x955b...), and AutopilotRouter without updating docs.
Deployer EOA 0x123c... self-revoked DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on AccessController after 223.57 days, leaving two 6-of-11 Safes (0x8b4334... and 0x6c4D84...) as RBAC admins.
Safe 0x8b4334... granted DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on immutable AccessController to 6-of-14 Safe 0xa9900B2d550c406d1Cf58DA27228Feeef21D447b (42.9% quorum), expanding admin surface to 3 Safes.
AutopilotRouterSet rotated autoPoolRouter() to 0x39ff6d21204B919441d17bef61D19181870835A2; docs updated this address but left stale SystemSecurity and SwapRouter entries unchanged.
Controller Safe 0x8b4334... completed its third signer swap (RemovedOwner 0x5A30..., AddedOwner 0x8969...) preserving 6-of-11 threshold alongside active Allowance Module 0xCFbF....
Latest RewardTokenAdded registry event confirms SystemRegistry remains non-proxy and owned directly by zero-timelock 6-of-11 Safe 0x8b4334... with no Governor contract deployed.

evidence_sources.claim_summary: Last pre-deployment commit touching src/SystemRegistry.sol in Tokemak/v2-core-pub prior to mainnet deployment on 2024-08-30; repository froze after 2024-10-15.
Latest operational configuration commit in Tokemak/v2-config showing active JSON config maintenance (16 commits across 2 engineers) while Solidity repos remain dormant.
Tokemak Snapshot governance space (toke.eth) showing a single historical 2022 foundation proposal (TRU-1) and no subsequent Snapshot votes for Autopools or SystemRegistry.
Official docs state SystemRegistry uses onlyOwner 'which will be granted to a multisig and eventually a Governor contract' and call AccessController unchangeable.
Official Ethereum contract table publishes current AutopilotRouter (0x39ff...) but still lists obsolete 2024 SystemSecurity (0x027a...) and SwapRouter (0x6201...) addresses.

gap_windows.summary: Deployer EOA 0x123cC4AFA59160C6328C0152cf333343F510e5A3 held unilateral SystemRegistry.owner() control for 17.68 days before OwnershipTransferred to 6-of-11 Safe 0x8b4334....
Deployer EOA 0x123c... retained DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on immutable AccessController 0x37767c... alongside Safe multisigs for 223.57 days until self-revocation at block 22,239,605.
Official docs retain obsolete 2024 SystemSecurity (0x027a...) and SwapRouter (0x6201...) addresses 653.10 days after block 21,775,447 replacement, and promised Governor control remains unimplemented.

executive_risk_memo: Between August 2024 and November 2026, AUTOfinance (Tokemak Autopools) transitioned SystemRegistry (0x2218F90A98b0C070676f249EF44834686dAa4285) from an initial 17.68-day deployer EOA bootstrap window to a zero-timelock 6-of-11 Gnosis Safe (0x8b4334d4812C530574Bd4F2763FcD22dE94A969B) carrying an active Allowance Module (0xCFbFaC74C26F8647cBDb8c5caf80BB5b32E43134) and three 2025-2026 signer rotations, while the deployer EOA retained overlapping DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE privileges on immutable AccessController (0x37767cBfF88Cb623E9404e959560984F7D742dF6) for 223.57 days until self-revocation at block 22,239,605 (repaired gap mean MTTR = 120.63 days). In May 2025, RBAC admin oversight expanded to three distinct Safes by adding a 6-of-14 Safe (42.9% quorum). Crucially, a 653.10-day disclosure and governance gap remains unrepaired at finalized block 26,452,182: official docs still list obsolete 2024 SystemSecurity and SwapRouter addresses replaced on 2025-02-04, never migrated SystemRegistry ownership to a promised Governor contract, and reflect zero trailing 12-month smart-contract commits in dormant Tokemak/v2-core-pub (bus factor 0; post-2024 SystemSecurityL1 and router swaps lack pre-deployment source commits in the public repo, while Tokemak/v2-config saw 16 config updates across 2 engineers).

result.method: Batched JSON-RPC reads pinned to the block hash (EIP-1898); EIP-1967 / EIP-1822 / beacon proxies; capabilities from PUSH4 selectors in proxy + implementation bytecode (heuristic).
result.summary: Controlled by a 6-of-11 Safe with no timelock: changes can land instantly once signers agree.

assessment.method: Live bytecode + storage heuristic at the pinned block, cross-checked with Pacta's RPC-pinned record for AUTOfinance (block 26451608).
limits: riskScore (0-100) is a heuristic of the controller type and of pause / blacklist / upgrade capabilities read at one block; it is not an audit.

The live check reads EIP-1967 slots, owner(), Safe getThreshold() / getOwners() and TimelockController getMinDelay(); custom role systems, bridge or L2 admin paths and off-chain operations are not resolved.
Documentation is compared only for indexed protocols (catalogMatch), at their pinned block.

upgrade_x402.note: Free tier: 50 pre-flight calls per caller per UTC day (REST and MCP), then $0.01 per call over x402 (HTTP 402, never a dead-end 429). Paid routes below: POST the JSON body with an x402 X-PAYMENT (v1) or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (v2) header.
